meta.title: Free diamond valuation | Valutazione Diamanti
meta.description: Send photos and your certificate: a gemmologist reviews your request and contacts you. Free, no obligation, appointment at our Milan office.

slots.valutazione-contenuto-007: La Diamanteria’s direct buying service. No auctions or intermediaries. Established in Milan in 2009.
slots.valutazione-contenuto-011: We assess natural diamonds of one carat or more per stone, smaller coloured gemstones and watches from the brands listed below.
slots.valutazione-contenuto-013: What would you like to sell?
slots.valutazione-contenuto-021: Carat weight of the main stone
slots.valutazione-contenuto-023: We do not buy laboratory-grown diamonds.
slots.valutazione-contenuto-026: We do not buy diamonds accompanied by AIG, GRA, GWLAB or ALGT reports.
slots.valutazione-contenuto-029: Optional: attach clear photographs of your item and any grading reports.
slots.valutazione-contenuto-031: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF. Up to 6 files, 5 MB each and 20 MB in total.
slots.valutazione-contenuto-038: La Diamanteria uses the contact details and attachments you submit to assess your item and respond to your valuation enquiry. Attachments can only be accessed by authorised administrators. Please do not upload identity documents: these are required only if you decide to sell to us. For information about how your data is used, contact info@valutazionediamanti.it.
slots.valutazione-contenuto-039: I have read the information about how my data will be used for this enquiry.
